name: Transfer Status 6 Code
definition: Specifies a transfer or settlement instruction status.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Transfer or settlement instruction has been acknowledged / accepted for further processing.

COSE.name: Already Executed
COSE.definition: Transfer or settlement instruction is fully executed and the confirmation is sent.

DELY.name: Delayed
DELY.definition: Transfer or settlement instruction is delayed.

MACH.name: Matched
MACH.definition: Transfer or settlement instruction is matched.

RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: Instruction has been received, that is, technical validation of the message is ok, and the message is now at the receiving side.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: Transfer or settlement instruction has been sent to the next party, that is, the next intermediary.

SETT.name: Settled
SETT.definition: Transfer or settlement instruction is settled.
